name: Green River (Desolation & Gray Canyons)
gaugeName: Green River at Green River, UT
blurb: Remote Desolation and Gray canyons below Sand Wash, plus the popular no-permit Green River Daily through lower Gray Canyon.

sections.notes: BLM permit required year-round. ~60 named Class II-III rapids; Joe Hutch Rapid can elevate to Class IV-V- at high water. East (river left) bank in Desolation is Uintah & Ouray Reservation - tribal permit needed to camp/hike there.

putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Price Field Office)
putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 88966 'Sand Wash' (Boat Ramp, UTG02000 Price FO)
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 88966 'Sand Wash' (Boat Ramp, UTG02000 Price FO) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Price FO: Sand Wash Ranger Station (https://www.blm.gov/visit/sand-wash-ranger-station): 'serves as the put in for floating Desolation and Gray Canyons ... a boat ramp'; permits required year-round. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/sand_wash_boat_ramp.png): the point is at the head of the graded slope that runs straight down to the river beside the ranger station. NHD flowline 72 m away.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~126), the point is right of the NHD centreline (72 m).

takeOutAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Price Field Office)
takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 77691 'Swasey Rapid Boat Ramp Site' (Boat Ramp, UTG02000)
takeOutAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 77691 'Swasey Rapid Boat Ramp Site' (Boat Ramp, UTG02000) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Price FO: Swaseys Boat Ramp (https://www.blm.gov/visit/swaseys-boat-ramp): 'serves as the take out for ... Desolation Canyon as well as the Green River Daily'; Geographic Coordinates 39.11229444, -110.1090278; no fees. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/swaseys_boat_ramp.png): the point is on the open launch beach at the water; the BLM page coordinate is about 15 m away on the same beach. NHD flowline 51 m away.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~223), the point is left of the NHD centreline (51 m).

sections.notes: Green River Daily: BLM - family friendly, Class I and II rapids, no permit required. BLM Nefertiti page says 8 river miles; WSR page 8.5.
